entries.english:
He confirms to the dean and chapter of Speyer Cathedral all privileges granted to that church by his imperial predecessors, and so forth. Witnesses: Gerlach, Archbishop of Mainz; Ruprecht der Ältere, Rhine Count Palatine; Rudolf, Duke of Saxony; Ruprecht der Jüngere, Rhine Count Palatine; the archbishops Arnest of Prague and Dietrich of Magdeburg; the bishops Johann von Leitomischl, chancellor of the court, Johann von Strasbourg, Johann von Olmütz, Ludwig von Halberstadt, Berthold von Eichstätt, and Peter von Chur; Heinrich, Landgrave of Hesse; the margraves Otto von Brandenburg and Friedrich von Meißen; Burchard, Burgrave of Magdeburg and steward of the court; the counts Eberhard and Ulrich von Wirtenberg, Heinrich and Gunther von Schwarzburg, Ulrich von Helfenstein, Burchard and Johann von Retz, Ludwig der Ältere and Ludwig der Jüngere von Oettingen; the nobles Ulrich von Hanau, Jodok von Rosenberg, Sbinko von Hasenburg, imperial chamberlain, and Peter von Michelberg. Remling, Charters of the Bishops of Speyer 1, 621. [The place of issue is Rotenberg northeast of Nuremberg.]

Witnesses: Gerlach, Archbishop of Mainz; Ruprecht der Ältere, Rhine Count Palatine; Rudolf, Duke of Saxony; Ruprecht der Jüngere, Rhine Count Palatine; the archbishops Arnest of Prague and Dietrich of Magdeburg; the bishops Johann von Leitomischl, chancellor of the court, Johann von Strasbourg, Johann von Olmütz, Ludwig von Halberstadt, Berthold von Eichstätt, and Peter von Chur; Heinrich, Landgrave of Hesse; the margraves Otto von Brandenburg and Friedrich von Meißen; Burchard, Burgrave of Magdeburg and steward of the court; the counts Eberhard and Ulrich von Wirtenberg, Heinrich and Gunther von Schwarzburg, Ulrich von Helfenstein, Burchard and Johann von Retz, Ludwig der Ältere and Ludwig der Jüngere von Oettingen; the nobles Ulrich von Hanau, Jodok von Rosenberg, Sbinko von Hasenburg, imperial chamberlain, and Peter von Michelberg.
